# <emoji> <type>(<scope>): <subject>

#

# Types with Emojis:

# ✨ feat - New feature

# 🐛 fix - Bug fix

# 📝 docs - Documentation changes

# 💄 style - Code style changes (formatting, semicolons, etc.)

# ♻️ refactor - Code refactoring (no functional changes)

# ⚡ perf - Performance improvements

# ✅ test - Adding or updating tests

# 📦 build - Build system or dependencies

# 👷 ci - CI/CD configuration

# 🔧 chore - Other changes (maintenance, tooling, etc.)

# 🎉 init - Initial commit

# 🔥 remove - Removing code or files

# 🚀 deploy - Deployment related

# 🔒 security - Security fixes

#

# Scope (optional): component, feature, or area affected

#

# Subject: imperative mood, lowercase, no period

# - "add user authentication" not "added user authentication"

# - "fix login bug" not "Fixed login bug."

#

# Examples:

# ✨ feat(auth): add user login functionality

# 🐛 fix(api): resolve timeout issue on slow networks

# 📝 docs: update README with setup instructions

#

# Body (optional): explain what and why, not how

#

# Footer (optional): breaking changes, issue references

# - BREAKING CHANGE: description

# - Fixes #123, Closes #456
